app.name: Business Suite
app.tagline: Desktop POS for shops and retail — sales, stock, and debts, for almost any storefront

dashboard.intro: Operational snapshot from the local database. Switch period to review short trends, priorities, and stock pressure before you start the day.

summary.salesAria: Approximate US dollars: {{usd}}. Total in Lebanese pounds: {{lbp}}
summary.footnote: Values use local device time and selected period. Approximate US dollars = total LBP ÷ rate in Settings.

topProducts.empty: No sold products in this period yet.

entry.title: Scan or search
entry.hint: Focus stays here for fast entry. Press Enter or tap Add to put a line on the ticket.
entry.placeholder: Type or scan the full code, then Enter…
entry.demoCodes: Only products from Products & stock. Enter the full SKU or full barcode (exact, not partial). Unknown values show an error. Quantity cannot exceed on-hand stock.
entry.exactCodeOnly: Match must be the full SKU or the full stored barcode, character-for-character (after spaces are trimmed). The Code column on the ticket shows the value you used. No partial match.

cart.title: Current ticket
cart.emptyBody: Scan or type the product’s full SKU or barcode to add the first line. This area will list items, quantities, and line totals.

products.intro: The catalog is stored in the local database on this computer. Add products here; they are available in POS by SKU or barcode. Define categories in the “Product categories” tab, then assign them to products and filter the catalog.

form.scannerHint: USB/Bluetooth barcode or QR readers in keyboard mode type into the focused field and often send Enter after the code. Enter goes to the next field; use Add (or Save) when you’re done — it does not auto-save on scan.

debts.intro: Each row’s balance = all on-account sales (charges) minus all recorded payments. Use the wallet action to record a payment, and the eye action to open full history in a pop-up: every charge and payment, with the note saved for each.

cashflow.intro: Latest mixed operations: cash sales, on-account sales, customer payments, supplier payments, and expenses. Void is available only for today’s cash sales.
cashflow.hintVoid: Void restores stock and hides the sale from reports and dashboard. Only same-day cash sales can be voided.

voidDialog.title: Void this cash sale?
voidDialog.body: Stock will be restored and the sale will be excluded from totals. This is meant for quick corrections.

errors.not_cash_sale: Only cash sales can be voided here.
errors.void_not_same_day: Only sales from today (local date) can be voided.

reports.loadError: Could not load the sales report. Check the database, then try again.
reports.intro: Summaries and daily totals are read from sales saved on this device (cash and on-account). Pick a period or a custom from/to range, then Apply.

empty.title: No sales in this range
empty.body: There are no recorded sales between these dates. Complete a sale from POS, then run the report again or widen the range.

chart.title: Sales by day (LBP)
chart.hint: Approx. USD: {{usd}} (using the LBP/USD rate from Settings, not a live market rate).
chart.yCaption: The vertical scale uses Lebanese pounds; numbers match the “Daily detail” table for each day.
chart.aria: Bar chart: {{n}} calendar day columns; left axis is LBP scale, bar height and labels are total LBP for that day.

settings.intro: Shop-wide preferences. General, interface, and printing choices are saved in the local database.

interface.classicMenuIntro: By default the app hides the full desktop menu bar (File / Edit / View) for a cleaner POS. Turn the option on if you need reload, DevTools, or the usual edit shortcuts (for support and advanced users).
interface.classicMenuTitle: Toggle the File/Edit/View menu bar (Windows and Linux: press Alt when the bar is auto-hidden and the menu is on).
interface.classicMenuHint: Takes effect immediately. On Windows and Linux the menu may stay hidden until you press Alt or turn this on. On macOS a small app menu remains in the menu bar when this is off.
interface.navLayoutIntro: Show primary links in a left sidebar (default) or a single row under the shop name. Top bar mode gives the page the full width below, including the area the sidebar used to occupy.
interface.navLayoutSidebarHint: Navigation on the left; main content in the rest of the window.
interface.navLayoutTopHint: Horizontal links under the header; the main work area uses the full width of the content column.
interface.devToolsHint: When disabled, the "Dev Tools" link will be hidden from the sidebar for a cleaner interface.

general.lbpPerUsdHint: Used to show approximate US dollar amounts alongside Lebanese pounds (POS, debts, reports). This is a shop reference rate, not a live exchange feed.

language.note: Use the language control in the top bar to switch Arabic and English. This section will later hold regional formats.
